definitions.success: Committed card action; successful effect is NOT inferred from points
definitions.directPoints: Claimed points during action only; no causal estimate of scan/tractor future value
definitions.reversal: Final winners include someone not leading after penultimate completed round; omniscient retrospective score
definitions.order: Rotate actors including private star/wall supplies and policies across turn slots independently of physical seat; paired rotations share seeds and are NOT independent samples
definitions.random: Random legal candidate, not uniform over cards/positions
